# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-shortcuts-doc.mjs from apps/web/src/lib/keymap.ts. Do not edit. -->

Press <kbd>?</kbd> in Lifer to see these in the app. Lifer follows Lightroom's keys where Lightroom has one.

Mac keys are shown first. On Windows and Linux, <kbd>Cmd</kbd> (⌘) becomes <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>, <kbd>Option</kbd> (⌥) becomes <kbd>Alt</kbd>, and <kbd>Shift</kbd> (⇧) stays the same.

Keys that work only in the desktop app are marked (desktop app). Letter keys and digits do nothing while you are typing in a field.

## Everywhere

| Action                         | Mac   | Windows and Linux |
| ------------------------------ | ----- | ----------------- |
| Command palette                | `⌘K`  | `Ctrl+K`          |
| Find                           | `⌘F`  | `Ctrl+F`          |
| Settings                       | `⌘,`  | `Ctrl+,`          |
| Import photos                  | `⇧⌘I` | `Ctrl+Shift+I`    |
| Keyboard shortcuts             | `?`   | `?`               |
| Export                         | `⇧⌘E` | `Ctrl+Shift+E`    |
| Show or hide the sidebar       | `⌃⌘S` | `Ctrl+Alt+S`      |
| Go to Collection (desktop app) | `⌘1`  | `Ctrl+1`          |
| Go to Gallery (desktop app)    | `⌘2`  | `Ctrl+2`          |
| Go to Map (desktop app)        | `⌘3`  | `Ctrl+3`          |
| Go to Albums (desktop app)     | `⌘4`  | `Ctrl+4`          |
| Go to Stats (desktop app)      | `⌘5`  | `Ctrl+5`          |

## Gallery

| Action                  | Mac                                     | Windows and Linux                           |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| Open photo              | `Enter` or `E`                          | `Enter` or `E`                              |
| Peek at photo           | `Space`                                 | `Space`                                     |
| Compare selected photos | `C`                                     | `C`                                         |
| Larger cards            | `=`                                     | `=`                                         |
| Smaller cards           | `-`                                     | `-`                                         |
| Select every photo      | `⌘A`                                    | `Ctrl+A`                                    |
| Select none             | `⇧⌘A`                                   | `Ctrl+Shift+A`                              |
| Move to trash           | `Delete` or `Backspace` or `⌘Backspace` | `Delete` or `Backspace` or `Ctrl+Backspace` |

| Rate 4 stars                    | `4`                | `4`                    |
| Rate 5 stars                    | `5`                | `5`                    |
| Clear rating                    | `0`                | `0`                    |

| Set as featured photo           | `K`                | `K`                    |
| Clear rating and go to the next | `⇧0`               | `Shift+0`              |
| Rate 1 star and go to the next  | `⇧1`               | `Shift+1`              |
| Rate 2 stars and go to the next | `⇧2`               | `Shift+2`              |
| Rate 3 stars and go to the next | `⇧3`               | `Shift+3`              |
| Rate 4 stars and go to the next | `⇧4`               | `Shift+4`              |

| Show a photo's versions         | `⇧A`               | `Shift+A`              |

## Video

| Action              | Mac     | Windows and Linux |
| ------------------- | ------- | ----------------- |
| Play or pause video | `Space` | `Space`           |
| Back 10 seconds     | `⇧←`    | `Shift+←`         |
| Forward 10 seconds  | `⇧→`    | `Shift+→`         |
| Back one frame      | `,`     | `,`               |
| Forward one frame   | `.`     | `.`               |

## Map

| Action                        | Mac        | Windows and Linux |
| ----------------------------- | ---------- | ----------------- |

| Zoom out of the region        | `-` or `_` | `-` or `_`        |
